content: Nawu Kawohrnan Rowk Kandjalmarnedjare Munguyhmunguyh, Wanjh Karrimanjbu!
Psalm 136
Nawu Yawey nakka nadjalmakkayhkenh, wanjh karrimanjbu! Nungka kandjalmarnedjare bu munguyhmunguyh!
Nungka wanjh God duninjh, dja kadjalwernhdokme gods nawu birribubuyika, wanjh karrimanjbu! Nungka kandjalmarnedjare bu munguyhmunguyh!
Nungka kabenmarnewohrnan rowk birribuyika nawu kabirriwohrnawohrnan, wanjh karrimanjbu! Nungka kandjalmarnedjare bu munguyhmunguyh!
Nungka nadjalkudji nawu kakurduyime kunwern kunmakmak ba bu karrikangebarrhme. Nungka kandjalmarnedjare bu munguyhmunguyh!
Nungka kawernhburrbun kunmayali rowk, wanjh marnbom kaddum kunngol. Nungka kandjalmarnedjare bu munguyhmunguyh!
Nungka bolkwarlahwong manbu kunrorre kore kurrula. Nungka kandjalmarnedjare bu munguyhmunguyh!
Nungka marnbom kundung dja mak dird. Nungka kandjalmarnedjare bu munguyhmunguyh!
Mak kundung marnbom ba kawohrnan ngarre manbu kunbarnangarra. Nungka kandjalmarnedjare bu munguyhmunguyh!
Mak dird dja mankokkarrng warridj marnbom bu kabirrimarnewohrnan ngarre kumunun. Nungka kandjalmarnedjare bu munguyhmunguyh!
Nawu Yawey benbom nadjaman binihbininj rowk nawu birrikang Egypt. Nungka kandjalmarnedjare bu munguyhmunguyh!
Mak benbebkeng bininj nawu Israel benkebmawahmeng kore Egypt birrihbongdi. Nungka kandjalmarnedjare bu munguyhmunguyh!
Nungka bidyirriyonginj ba bu benmarnekurduyimeng kore kundulkarre dja kunngudj nuye. Nungka kandjalmarnedjare bu munguyhmunguyh!
Kaluk nungka kurrula bodjalkmey manbu Red Sea. Nungka kandjalmarnedjare bu munguyhmunguyh!
Dja benberlkang bininj nawu Israel benkebmawahmeng kore kuburldjarn mankabo dja benyidjowkeng borledmikenh. Nungka kandjalmarnedjare bu munguyhmunguyh!
Dja nungka benkebngakkeng nawu Pharaoh dja nuye soldiers kore Red Sea.Nungka kandjalmarnedjare bu munguyhmunguyh!
Mak nawu Yawey benkani bininj nuye kore kubolkdarleh birrirey. Nungka kandjalmarnedjare bu munguyhmunguyh!
Nungka benbom birrikihkimuk kings nawu birriwohrnawohrnani kumekke. Nungka kandjalmarnedjare bu munguyhmunguyh!
Benbularrbom rowk nawu birridulkarrekimuk kings. Nungka kandjalmarnedjare bu munguyhmunguyh!
Nungka bibom King Sihon nawu benmarnewohrnani bedberre bininj nawu birringeyyoy Amor. Nungka kandjalmarnedjare bu munguyhmunguyh!
Warridj bibom king nawu ngeyyoy Og bu nungka benmarnewohrnani bininj kore kunbolk Bashan. Nungka kandjalmarnedjare bu munguyhmunguyh!
Dja mak bolkmangi manbu kings bedberre kunred dja benbolkwong bininj nuye. Nungka kandjalmarnedjare bu munguyhmunguyh!
Wanjh nungka benbolkwong bininj nawu birrimarnedurrkmirri, bedda nawu Israel benkebmawahmeng. Nungka kandjalmarnedjare bu munguyhmunguyh!
Bu ngad yiman karrimarladj, wanjh nawu Yawey kandjalburrbuni, dja minj kanbawoyi kadberre. Nungka kandjalmarnedjare bu munguyhmunguyh!
Mak kanbebkeng kore nawu karriyidko bininj kandibongkarrmi. Nungka kandjalmarnedjare bu munguyhmunguyh!
Mak nungka marnbom mayh rowk kore kurrula dja wanjh kabenwonowon manme. Nungka kandjalmarnedjare bu munguyhmunguyh!
Wanjh karrimanjbu God nawu kahni kore kaddum heaven! Nungka kandjalmarnedjare bu munguyhmunguyh!
